title: FactSet Research Systems (FDS) Discounted Despite AI Workflow Integration

content_html:
Soumya Eswaran

Mon, August 17, 2026 at 8:33 AM CDT 4 min read

Baron Capital, an investment management company, released its Q2 2026 letter for "Baron Partners Fund". A copy of the letter can be downloaded here. Baron Partners Fund reported a 16.61% (Institutional Shares) gain in Q2, outperforming both the Russell Midcap Growth Index (14.55%) and the Russell 3000 Index (15.44%). Year-to-date, it has returned 10.40%, exceeding the Russell Midcap Growth Index's 7.27%. Its one-year return is at 48.75%, significantly ahead of the Index (6.17%) and the Market Index (22.82%). The Fund has consistently outperformed the Index in 4 out of the last 5 years. With a focus on a concentrated portfolio, the Fund invests in 28 companies, primarily in the top 10 positions, which account for 74.1% of total investments. The median market capitalization of these companies is $20.9 billion. The strategy focuses on growth businesses expected to double in value within 5-6 years, utilizing proprietary research to ensure competitive advantages and sustainable growth opportunities, while employing leverage for enhanced returns and increased volatility. Additionally, reviewing the Fund's top five holdings could help identify its best picks for 2026.

In its Q2 2026 investor letter, Baron Partners Fund highlighted FactSet Research Systems Inc. (NYSE:FDS) a leading financial data company that provides integrated financial information and analytical applications for the investment community. FactSet Research Systems Inc. (NYSE:FDS) rose 6.34% in the quarter and contributed 0.31% to the Fund's performance. On August 14, 2026, FactSet Research Systems Inc. (NYSE:FDS) closed at $283.49 per share, reflecting a market capitalization of $10.08 billion. FactSet Research Systems Inc. (NYSE:FDS) posted a one‑month return of 10.83%, while its shares lost 23.62% over the past 52 weeks."

Baron Partners Fund stated the following regarding FactSet Research Systems Inc. (NYSE:FDS) in its Q2 2026 investor letter:

"FactSet Research Systems Inc. (NYSE:FDS) is a leading provider of financial data, analytics, and technology solutions to investment professionals globally. The shares came under pressure as investors continued to discount the business for perceived AI disruption risk. We believe the market significantly understates FactSet's positioning as AI becomes more deeply embedded in financial workflows, and in our view, FactSet is becoming critical AI infrastructure for the industry. FactSet has grown its organic annual subscription value 7% over the past year. CEO Sanoke Viswanathan noted on the most recent earnings call that momentum has continued. AI drove meaningful client expansions, with a top 10 bank doubling its data subscriptions. The company also announced a strategic partnership with Google Cloud to embed Gemini AI models into its workstation. FactSet now trades at a 52% discount to its 10-year average multiple and a 68% discount to its 5-year peak multiple. Management has repurchased $163 million in the most recent quarter.

This is not the first time the Fund has held investments that were temporarily out of favor while reinvesting in their businesses or navigating a period of investor skepticism. When the underlying issues are resolved, these stocks tend to perform exceptionally well. Diversification has served the Fund well during these stretches. The concentrated but categorically diversified structure of the portfolio allows the Fund to weather company-specific and sector specific headwinds with limited permanent capital impairment. The significant outperformance of our Disruptive Growth holdings in the quarter illustrates the benefits of this balance."

Baron Partners Fund 在其 2026 年第二季度投资者信中重点介绍了 FactSet Research Systems Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：FDS），这是一家领先的金融数据公司，为投资界提供综合金融信息和分析应用程序。 FactSet Research Systems Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：FDS）本季度上涨 6.34%，为该基金的业绩贡献了 0.31%。 2026 年 8 月 14 日，FactSet Research Systems Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：FDS）收盘价为每股 283.49 美元，市值为 100.8 亿美元。 FactSet Research Systems Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：FDS）公布的一个月回报率为 10.83%，而其股价在过去 52 周内下跌了 23.62%。”

“FactSet Research Systems Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：FDS）是一家为全球投资专业人士提供金融数据、分析和技术解决方案的领先提供商。 由于投资者因认为人工智能颠覆风险而继续对该业务进行折价，该公司股价面临压力。 我们认为，随着人工智能越来越深入地嵌入到金融工作流程中，市场大大低估了 FactSet 的定位，并且在我们看来，FactSet 正在成为该行业的关键人工智能基础设施。 FactSet 的有机年度订阅价值在过去一年增长了 7%。 首席执行官萨诺克·维斯瓦纳坦 (Sanoke Viswanathan) 在最近的财报电话会议上指出，这一势头仍在持续。 人工智能推动了有意义的客户扩张，一家十大银行的数据订阅量增加了一倍。 该公司还宣布与谷歌云建立战略合作伙伴关系，将 Gemini AI 模型嵌入其工作站。 FactSet 目前的交易价格较其 10 年平均市盈率折价 52%，较其 5 年峰值市盈率折价 68%。 管理层在最近一个季度回购了 1.63 亿美元。 这并不是该基金第一次持有在对其业务进行再投资或应对投资者怀疑时期时暂时失宠的投资。 当根本问题得到解决后，这些股票往往表现异常出色。 在这些时期，多元化对基金起到了良好的作用。 投资组合的集中但绝对多元化的结构使该基金能够以有限的永久性资本减值来应对特定公司和特定行业的逆风。 本季度我们持有的颠覆性增长股票的显着优异表现说明了这种平衡的好处。”
